Alligator Alcatraz was ordered to be closed. It is still open! I wonder if they threw bodies to the alligators? So many missing people, I would not put it past this administration. ICE MAZIS. IF AN INDIVIDUAL CAN BE PRESENT WHILE AN INFANT IS MURDERED AND TOSSED IN LAKE MICHIGAN. THEN YEAH!

Oh and the Great Lakes Serpentarium has a facebook page. It's a small alligator that someone must have left there so it was not the giant ones we have. It still deserved to be treated better by the supposed "owner".
